design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — seller_fees_and_selling_plans, task 0 (term change tree)

[Step 0 — draw and scope]
draw_counts.py --task 0 printed: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5, 6]}. Assignment: term change fee (root) 5 factors, discount dispute credit 6, chargeback credit 6, cancellation credit 4 — multiset {4,5,6,6} = the draw. Task 1 draw (--tasks 2): 1 prerequisite problem, factor counts [4, 6]; reserved for it and NOT claimed here: the early termination fee on closing a store early (seller's own act, user tool) and the refund credit on a seller-funded refund (agent), so task 1 keeps an independent root (closing the store) and an independent credit core (refunds). Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is first). Claimed here: selling_ext_discount_dispute_credit, selling_ext_chargeback_fee_credit, selling_ext_cancellation_fee_credit, selling_ext_term_change_fee and their four tools.
Design thesis. Surface goal (customer): "move my Premium Store from the annual to the monthly billing term and tell me what it costs". Core scored parameter: term_change_fee. Hidden chain: the term change fee's volume relief is read from the plan's net seller fees of the last twelve months, and its rule says the fee is "not worked out until every chargeback debited ... carries its chargeback credit" and "worked out only after every order the seller cancelled before shipment ... carries its cancellation credit"; the chargeback credit is in turn "fixed only after every fee dispute submitted on that order's variable final value fee record carries a decision". Depth: 2 hops (dispute -> chargeback credit -> term change fee). Breadth: 4 computations, 21 factors, reading the selling ledger (subscription charges, FVF, credits), the standing record and defects, the payments ledger and plan, and the FBN enrollment and shipments.

[Known blueprint conflict — recorded, unresolved inside the write domain]
Every money-bearing selling event family declares a trigger into payout (selling_fee_credit -> payout_fee_reversal, selling_early_termination_fee -> payout_fee_deduction, unconditional). The skill forbids a task tool from writing a row whose values satisfy such a trigger, but the frozen blueprint leaves this difficulty no write that carries an amount without one (plan change, cancel scheduling, withdraw, close and lift carry no number; dispute intake rows carry no amount), and its own summary says "The agent books fee credits, upheld disputes, plan changes". The tools here therefore book the selling-side rows only and never write payout; the payments-side mirror (fee reversal / fee deduction) is the payments system's own consequence and no task step is expected to write it. Flagged for the orchestrator.

[Problem-tree card]
root: selling_ext_term_change_fee (target switch_store_to_monthly_term_ae40bf8f, owner=user — the seller confirms the move himself, per the base lifecycle "The seller moves to another plan or billing term" and the persona).
edge 1: term change fee -> chargeback credit. kind value_input, gate tc_net_fees, form state. Sentence (negated direction, as a billing desk states a quote that cannot be issued yet): "The term change fee is not worked out until every chargeback debited to the seller's payments account in the last twelve months carries its chargeback credit on the order's variable final value fee record." Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; waits on a record-visible state (a chargeback-credit row on the variable fee record); names no tool/id/token; scope = chargebacks of the last twelve months, the same window the volume relief reads. Exactly one write brings it about: the chargeback credit tool (the refund-credit policy of task 1 credits seller refunds, not chargebacks). Unresolved at frozen_time: chargeback debit (payout_events, 2026-10-03, 620.00) on the Velden order and its variable fee record carries no order-refund credit; the only order-refund credit on the plan is the 2025-07-30 chargeback's. Resolved by book_chargeback_fee_credit_32d8a153 (agent).
edge 2: term change fee -> cancellation credit. kind value_input, gate tc_net_fees, form state, affirmative direction: "The term change fee is worked out only after every order the seller cancelled before shipment in the last twelve months carries its cancellation credit on the order's variable final value fee record." Unresolved: seller cancellation defect 2026-09-18 on the Sarabeth mixer order, its variable fee record has no credit (the March cancellation is already credited). Resolved by book_cancellation_fee_credit_79bf63bc (agent); only that tool books order-cancellation credits.
edge 3: chargeback credit -> discount dispute credit. kind value_input, gate kc_prior, form state, affirmative: "The chargeback credit on an order is fixed only after every fee dispute submitted on that order's variable final value fee record carries a decision." Unresolved: dispute (standing_discount_missing) on the Velden variable fee is submitted. Resolved by uphold_fee_dispute_credit_4fd06f6c (agent), the only write that records a dispute decision.
Topological order: dispute credit -> chargeback credit -> cancellation credit -> term change (the cancellation credit commutes with the first two; proved by replay: cancellation first gives the same 149.62 and the same 43.20).
Deletion sensitivity (actual run, round 2): skip chargeback credit -> term change fee 32.40 (net fees 4,025.90, volume relief 0.30) instead of 43.20; skip cancellation credit -> 32.40 (net 4,126.80); skip dispute decision -> chargeback credit 52.70 (gross 56.00, admin 3.30) instead of 48.72 (kc_prior 0.00). value_input edges = 3 >= max(3-1,1)=2. The persona never names any of the three; tools never check them.

[Factor card — handling-time values from the verification run]
Discount dispute credit (6; 5 parameter, 1 method): level_discount_rate parameter — level in force on the 2026-09-23 fee date is Top Rated (set at the 2026-09-20 evaluation, on or before the fee date) + FBN shipment of the order -> 0.12 (baseline 0.10 -> result 3.92); volume_window method (window convention: which fee records enter the measured basis) — FBN Starter active, 340 units (<500) -> 3-month window (baseline 1 month: basis 3,040 -> no bonus -> 3.92); volume_bonus parameter — basis 9,670.00 in the window -> 0.02 (baseline 0 -> 3.92); near-miss: the 2026-07-06 order (4,200) is exactly 3 whole months back and falls outside; handling_bonus parameter — FBN shipment same day -> 0.01 (baseline 0 -> 4.20); tenure_bonus parameter — 30 months -> 0.01 (-> 4.20); defect_adjustment parameter (selects the claim defect multiplier value 0.5) — chargeback defect on the order (-> 8.96). Result 4.48 = min(RND(56.00 x 0.16 x 0.5), 56.00 - 0.00 credits already on the record); all-baseline 5.60.
Chargeback credit (6; 5 parameter, 1 method): chargeback_share_rule method — 620/640 = 0.96875 >= 0.9 -> counted as one instead of the ratio (baseline proportional -> 47.30); chargeback_admin_rate parameter, multi-source (chargeback debits dated less than twelve whole months back AND level) — 1 debit, Top Rated -> 0.10 (baseline 0.20 -> 47.02); near-miss: the 2025-07-30 chargeback is 14 months old and does not count; chargeback_admin_cap parameter — basis 640 -> 7.50 (baseline 5.00 -> 49.52); chargeback_timing_multiplier parameter — 10 days -> multiplier value 1.5 (baseline 1 -> 50.66); chargeback_tenure_multiplier parameter — 30 months -> multiplier value 0.75 (baseline 1 -> 47.02); fbn_chargeback_relief parameter — FBN shipment same day -> 3.00 (-> 45.72). Result 48.72 (gross 51.52 = 56.00 - 4.48, admin min(5.80,7.50) - 3.00 = 2.80); all-baseline 44.91.
Cancellation credit (4; 3 parameter, 1 method): late_cancellation_share parameter — 3 days -> share value 0.75 (baseline whole -> 200.00); cancellation_admin_rate parameter, multi-source (seller-cancellation count in the record window AND level) — 2 cancellations, Top Rated -> 0.05 (baseline none -> 157.50); cancellation_admin_cap parameter — basis 2,400 -> 10.00 (baseline 5.00 binds the 7.88 fee -> 152.50); cancellation_record_window method (window convention: which defects are counted) — plan verified 30 whole months ago (>= 24) -> last 12 whole months, holding both the 2026-09-18 and the 2026-03-11 cancellations (baseline standard 6-month window holds only the September one -> count 1 -> no fee -> 157.50). Result 149.62 (gross 157.50, admin min(7.88, 10.00) = 7.88); all-baseline 210.00.
Term change fee (5; 4 parameter, 1 method): repaid_charge_lookback method — 30 months -> last 6 of 7 charges (baseline all 7 -> 50.40); volume_relief parameter — net seller fees dated less than twelve whole months before 2026-10-08, after the credits, 3,977.18 -> 0.15 (baseline 0 -> 54.00); near-miss: before the credits 4,180.00 sits in the 0.30 band, and the 2025-10-06 order is exactly twelve whole months back and falls outside; standing_relief parameter, multi-source (level AND active violation points) — Top Rated, 0 points (the December listing violation expired in June) -> 0.20 (-> 57.60); payout_plan_relief parameter, multi-source (payout plan AND balance) — Payments Daily, positive -> 0.05 (-> 46.80); fbn_stock_multiplier parameter, multi-source (status AND units) — active, 340 -> multiplier value 0.8 (-> 54.00). Result 43.20 = 15.00 x 6 x 0.60 x 0.8; all-baseline 105.00.
Cross-difficulty factors: standing (level rate, defect adjustment, admin rates, standing relief, cancellation timing), payout (chargeback share/rate/timing, payout plan relief), fulfill (volume window, handling bonus, FBN relief, FBN multiplier). No rule reads the standing_discount_applied stamp; it is false on the disputed record and is exactly what the dispute contests.

[Overrides (overwrite) — no second product law]
Discount dispute credit replaces base "An upheld dispute credits the overcharged difference with no administration fee" and the base discount sentence of selling_final_value_fees (the discount dispute rate is a composed rate; the level is the level in force on the fee date); chargeback credit replaces the base refund-credit sentence that credited only seller refunds; cancellation credit replaces "A refund on an order cancelled before shipment is credited in full" (by the late-cancellation share) and "with no administration fee." (by the record-window administration fee) as two declared entries; term change fee replaces "A move to a lower plan, or from the annual to the monthly term, takes effect at the plan's downgrade effective point." (the move still takes effect at that point, and a term change fee is billed). Every other base clause (dispute window, one credit per fee and reason, never-exceed — now also enforced in the discount dispute credit, not-restricted gate, collection by deduction) is inherited.

[Base-invariant card]
Credits (steps 14/16/18): selling_refund_fee_credit.one_credit_per_fee_and_reason — "Credits on one fee record, administration fees included, never exceed the fee billed."; evidence: the target variable fee records carry no credit of the same reason at the opening; after the dispute credit (4.48) the chargeback credit's gross is sized on 56.00 - 4.48, so the two credits together (4.48 + 51.52) equal the 56.00 billed and never exceed it. selling_fee_disputes.dispute_window (time): anchor selling_fees.event_date, 90 calendar days, not_after, inclusive. Velden fee 2026-09-23 -> window to 2026-12-22; Sarabeth fee 2026-09-15 -> to 2026-12-14; frozen 2026-10-08 inside both; a fee dated 2026-07-09 or earlier would be outside.
Term change (step 20): selling_plan_change_rules.not_restricted — plan status active (allowed: active, cancel_scheduled); selling_cancellation applies by scope only (it governs early-termination fee records and the seller's own term decisions; its only gate concerns withdrawing a scheduled cancellation). The term change fee is its own quantity, defined in the term change rule; the base early-termination clause prices the term only when the plan closes, which this move does not do (audit O-8).

[Business-object card]
Dispute credit object: dispute (standing_discount_missing, submitted) -> variable fee record of the Velden VM-8 order (basis 640.00, 56.00 billed, discount not applied, FBN shipped same day). Excluded: the upheld duplicate-fee dispute of January (already credited 0.40). Chargeback object: the most recent chargeback debit (2026-10-03, 620.00) -> same variable fee record; the 2025-07-30 chargeback on the Rennick order already carries its credit (71.25 = 78.75 - 7.50, consistent with the chargeback rule at that time: share 1, rate 0.10, cap 7.50, 48 days, 15 months, no FBN). Cancellation object: the most recent seller cancellation defect (2026-09-18) -> Sarabeth SB-32 variable fee record (basis 2,400.00, 210.00 billed); the March cancellation (Pellow amp) already carries its 33.25 credit. Each credit names its fee record (fee_event_ref) and the reason; the tools copy plan, customer and order from that record.

[Seed rationale]
15 regular annual-term charges (Aug 2025 - Oct 2026) build the twelve-month net and the 7 charges of the current term (Apr-Oct 2026; the March charge belongs to the prior term — near-miss for the term window). 12 orders with variable + per-order FVF rows give the net-fee history (4,180.00 at the opening) and the 3-month basis; the duplicate per-order fee of January and its upheld credit are a settled correction (net 0). Payments ledger mirrors every fee (deduction), credit (reversal), sale, refund debit and chargeback, plus monthly payouts leaving 1,284.36 (Payments Daily, verified 2026-03-28 so no reverification hold). Standing: Top Rated, evaluated 2026-09-20, the expired violation pair keeps points at 0. FBN Starter (no unit minimum) with one inbound receipt of 341 units and the Velden shipment (340 on hand). Automatic clauses checked: no subscription is overdue (next bill 2026-11-02); balance never negative so no restriction; dispute window open; FBN not suspended.

[Persona design]
Thaddeus Wrenfield, brisk small-business owner; volunteers name, business, goal (annual -> monthly, same store, wants the charge and to do it today), refuses closing or changing plan; gives mobile 4045550231 and ZIP 30318 on request (tax ID 4406 as spare); defers internal references to the agent; confirms the switch himself only when handed it with the quoted charge; a single neutral conditional lets the agent book what is owed; questions surprising figures without supplying any; ends when the store shows the monthly term. No prerequisite, credit, dispute, chargeback or cancellation is mentioned.

[Standard solution]
Locate by name, verify by phone + ZIP; read plan, fees, disputes, orders, the cancelled order's activity, payments ledger and account, standing record and activity, FBN enrollment and activity. Decide the submitted dispute (credit 4.48, fee_dispute_upheld); book the chargeback credit on the same record (gross 51.52, admin 2.80, credit 48.72, order_refund); book the cancellation credit (gross 157.50, admin 7.88, credit 149.62, order_cancellation); then quote 43.20 and hand the switch to the seller, who confirms with selling_plan_id and 43.20.

[Verification]
Run with /tmp authoring helpers that import check_compute's build_env/eval_compute and replay the real tools between steps (round 2 values): B 4.48 (factor baselines 3.92/3.92/3.92/4.20/4.20/8.96, all 5.60); K 48.72 (47.30/47.02/49.52/50.66/47.02/45.72, all 44.91); C 149.62 (200.00/157.50/152.50/157.50, all 210.00); T 43.20 (50.40/54.00/57.60/46.80/54.00, all 105.00); T at the opening 32.40 (net 4,180.00); skip K 32.40; skip C 32.40; K without B 52.70; cancellation-first order gives identical values. The gate results are in the gate log below.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context]
Reading only the published rules, the tool schemas, the finder returns and the persona: the caller wants the term change; its rule names two waiting states (chargeback credits, cancellation credits) that the ledger and standing records show unmet; the chargeback credit's rule names the pending dispute; each credit rule names its order by the most recent chargeback debit / seller cancellation defect / submitted dispute; the arithmetic above follows sentence by sentence and reaches the same four values. No second reading changes the object or the order.

[Gate log]
Round 1 gate block (superseded by the round-2 log below): all green.
Revisions recorded during authoring: (1) credit tools gained a credit_reason enum argument — symptom: the one-credit-per-fee-and-reason gate binds selling_fees.credit_reason to an action argument; change propagated to all four credit tools, GT arguments and tracing. (2) Buyer customer rows and unread order activity removed — symptom: REPLAY closure mismatch (rows no gold read touches) and empty-string foreign keys; orders keep no buyer reference, only the activity of the order the agent reads is seeded. (3) Cross-difficulty bindings — symptom: a factor labelled cross-difficulty did not itself read the other category; the chargeback timing factor now owns the chargeback debit date and the late-cancellation factor owns the defect date. (4) Refund admin rate evidence moved from "defect on the refunded order" (absence matched no row) to "order defect within the last recent-defect months"; the seeded August refund credit was recomputed under the rule on its own date (rate 0.20, net 10.84) and the twelve-month net re-derived (12,030.08 -> 11,966.23).

[Round 2 — responses to audits/policy_task/seller_fees_and_selling_plans (_difficulty.md, 0.md, 1.md), by item id]
F-1 / 1-F1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED, refund credit undeclared override) — CLOSED. selling_ext_refund_fee_credit.overwrite now declares base selling_refund_fee_credit "the variable final value fee of that order is credited in proportion to the refunded share of the fee basis" replaced_by the rule's refunded-share sentence ("For the variable fee credit, the refunded share is counted as one when ... as half of the proportional share when ... and as the proportional share between the two"), alongside the existing administration-fee entry. The base proportional reading (129.10) is now retired by declaration; the scored step-13 values of task 1 (68.80 / 4.95 / 63.85) are unchanged.
F-2 / 0-F1 / 1-F2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED, multiplier ladders labelled method) — CLOSED. The eight ladders whose tiers only substitute a number are now labelled effect: parameter with value tiers (dd.defect_adjustment, tc.fbn_stock_multiplier, kc.chargeback_timing_multiplier, kc.chargeback_tenure_multiplier, rc.refund_frequency_multiplier, rc.refund_tenure_multiplier, cx.late_cancellation_share; et.renewal_grace_months was replaced, below). Remaining method factors per computation: dd.volume_window, tc.repaid_charge_lookback, kc.chargeback_share_rule, rc.refunded_share_rule (the four the auditor accepted), plus two genuine new ones: cx.cancellation_record_window (window convention — the plan's tenure selects a 12-, 9- or 6-month window over which seller cancellation defects are counted; it replaces the prompt_refund_relief factor so the drawn count 4 is kept) and et.renewal_month_rule (three different algorithms for the months counted: grace commitment months less the months from term start to next billing date after an automatic renewal within the grace days; none in the renewal notice period before term end; otherwise the billing dates still to come). Counts: dd 6 (5p/1m), tc 5 (4p/1m), kc 6 (5p/1m), cx 4 (3p/1m), rc 6 (5p/1m), et 4 (3p/1m) — the multisets still equal the draws {4,5,6,6} and {4,6}.
O-1 (uuid prefix 4fd shared by two tools) — CLOSED. The end-term tool was renamed with a freshly generated uuid8: end_store_term_early_4fd1aef8 -> end_store_term_early_0def8036 (single uuid.uuid4().hex[:8] call), propagated to task_tools.py, the charter's target_tool and tasks/1.json. No two tool suffixes now share a 3-hex prefix (4fd06f6c, 32d8a153, 79bf63bc, ae40bf8f, a1b0f084, 0def8036).
O-2 (discount dispute credit read the current level) — CLOSED. The rule now states the level in force on the disputed fee record's date (the level of the latest evaluation dated on or before that date; when the latest evaluation is later, no level is on record and the standard rate applies), and dd_level implements the guard via last_evaluation_date. Task 0: evaluation 2026-09-20 <= fee 2026-09-23, value unchanged.
O-3 (early termination sentence broader than the refund credit's cancelled-order exclusion) — CLOSED for the sentence: it now waits on refunds "for an order that shipped", and the edge condition says so. The refund credit's object finder (latest seller-funded refund debit) is unchanged; in task 1 the latest debit is on a shipped (FBN-delivered) order, so rule and compute agree there. Residual: a world whose latest refund debit is a cancelled order would need the agent to skip it by the rule; not exercised.
O-4 (twelve-month counting convention) — CLOSED. The net-fee sentences of the term change fee and the early termination fee now read "each counted when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date"; the chargeback admin rate reads "chargeback debits dated less than twelve whole months before the decision date"; the cancellation count now uses the explicit record window ("a window of that many whole months takes the seller cancellation defects dated less than that many whole months before the decision date"). All match the rolling MONTHS(d, NOW) < N evaluation.
O-5 (chargeback liability vs reversal) — NO CHANGE, with evidence: the payments charter debits a chargeback only when the order's liability party is the seller ("chargeback_liability_follows_order_liability"), so a debited chargeback is seller-liable when debited; a later won reversal is a separate payments event and none is seeded in task 0 (only payout_chargeback_debit / payout_chargeback_fee rows exist for the case).
O-6 (remaining months 10 vs 11 billing months) — CLOSED. The early termination baseline now counts "the billing dates still to come in the term: the whole calendar months from the next billing date to the term end date, plus one for the next billing date itself" (11 in task 1), and both user tools record remaining_term_months the same way (+1).
O-7 (no write records a rejected dispute) — NO CHANGE: base "a rejected dispute books nothing" and the difficulty claims no reject event; the chargeback edge is exercised only where the dispute is upheld (task 0, standing level and same-day handling qualify). Recorded as a scope limit.
O-8 (term change fee called an early end of the annual term without an overwrite on selling_cancellation) — CLOSED by wording: the term change rule no longer calls its fee "an early end of the annual term"; it bills "a term change fee ... on the move" while the plan stays open, and the base early-termination clause (conditioned on the plan closing) stays untouched; selling_cancellation is kept in base_policy_refs only because its subject covers the fee record family.
Other observations: discount dispute credit never-exceed — CLOSED (rule sentence "The discount dispute credit is never more than the variable fee billed on the disputed record less the credits already booked on that record" and result = MN(raw, billed - prior)); cancellation relief silent on "no refund debit" — moot (the prompt-refund relief factor was removed); cx/et replaced_by under-describing — CLOSED (each base clause is now split into two declared entries, one per replacing sentence); realism notes on dd bonuses, tc payout relief and halved small-refund shares — no change, these are world rules stated in full in the charter; payments-mirror gap — unchanged, a frozen-blueprint conflict reported to the orchestrator.
Stale-text sweep: factor_trace labels and values, factor_sensitivity tier_taken (now quoted from the ladders), baseline_result, argument tracing, prerequisite_closure (flips_to_true_by, order_uniqueness, edge_load_bearing), read-node necessity text and this dossier were regenerated from the recomputed values; no round-1 figure that changed (cancellation credit 151.62 -> 149.62, admin 5.88 -> 7.88, net 3,975.18 -> 3,977.18, skip-K net 4,023.90 -> 4,025.90, early termination 374.94 -> 161.97) remains outside the clearly marked round-1 revision notes.

[Gate log — round 2]
Full difficulty block re-run from the repository root after the round-2 changes, actual lines: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (6 tools); REPLAY OK (0.json 21 acts det True nonvac True closure 149/149 match True; 1.json 16 acts det True nonvac True closure 206/206 match True); SOLVABILITY OK (0.json 4 calls 8 base gates 44 seed rows; 1.json 2 calls 5 base gates 73 seed rows); COMPUTE OK (0.json 4 comps 21 factors 12 cross-difficulty; 1.json 2 comps 10 factors 5 cross-difficulty; suite means branches 56.00 steps 18.50; history_rows_max 72; branches_max 79); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (no cache trap designed); SCOPE OK. check_traceability stays deferred to the KB render step; validate_scenario reports only "required document ... not found" for this difficulty.


[Round 3 — render-layer source items]
R3-1 (renewal definition, rule vs compute) — CLOSED. The rule defines a renewed term as one "whose start date is later than the plan's verification date"; the compute read MONTHS(verified_date, term_start_date) > 0, which treats a term starting within a month of verification as not renewed. The realistic definition is the rule's: a plan's first term starts at verification, so any later start is a renewal. et_renewed is now DAYS(F('verified_date'), F('term_start_date')) and the tier tests et_renewed > 0, so rule and compute agree day for day. Task 1: verification 2023-09-15, term start 2026-09-15, et_renewed 1,096 days > 0, the same tier as before; no scored value moves (refund credit 63.85, early termination fee 161.97, factor baselines 890.85/221.96/191.97/209.96, all-baseline 1,649.72).
R3-2 (refund-count window wording, O-4 remainder) — CLOSED. The refund credit's frequency sentence and ladder now read "seller-funded refund debits dated less than three whole months before the decision date", matching the rolling XCOUNT(within_months=3) evaluation (0 <= MONTHS(event_date, NOW) < 3). Task 1 count is unchanged at 2 (2026-10-01 and 2026-08-12).
R3-3 (retired base formulas: refund administration fee, net credit, early termination fee) — NO CHANGE, with evidence. An overwrite can only name a clause of the base policy's rule (check_extended requires superseded_clause to be a verbatim substring of the base rule), and the base formula blocks are the machine face of rule clauses that are already declared: refund_admin_fee_amount = min(round(gross x rate, 2), cap) is the clause "less a refund administration fee of the admin rate times that credit, capped at the admin fee cap" (declared superseded by the refund credit; the chargeback credit supersedes the whole sentence that contains it); net_credit = gross - admin is not retired — every credit here still books the credit before the fee less the fee; early_termination_fee = round(annual fee x remaining months x share, 2) keeps its shape in the early termination rule, and the two clauses it encodes ("an early termination fee of the early termination share" and "times the remaining committed monthly fees (whole months from the next billing date to the term end) is billed") are both declared superseded.
user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Wrenfield, the owner of Wrenfield Pro Audio Supply LLC, which sells studio and live-sound equipment on Northloop through your Premium Store called Wrenfield Pro Audio. You are calling because you want to move your store from the annual billing term to the monthly billing term — the same Premium Store, the same store, just billed month to month from now on. Your sales always slow down over the winter and you want the freedom to step down later without being locked in. You have read that leaving the annual term early is not free, so you want the representative to tell you what the switch will cost and then get it done today. You are not closing the store and you are not moving to a different plan; if the representative suggests either, you say no, you only want the monthly billing term.

You speak plainly and a little briskly, like someone who runs a busy small shop. You give your name, Thaddeus Wrenfield, and your business name, Wrenfield Pro Audio Supply LLC, when you start. You give identity details only when the representative asks for them: your registered mobile number is 4045550231 and your billing ZIP code is 30318; if they ask for one more detail, the last four digits of your tax ID are 4406. You do not know any internal reference numbers and you tell the representative to look them up.

The switch is your own decision and you want to confirm it yourself rather than have the representative do it for you. Only once the representative has told you the exact charge for the switch and handed the switch over to you to confirm do you carry it out, entering exactly the charge the representative quoted. If the representative says that something on your account has to be put right before the charge can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead and book whatever is owed to you, and you wait while they do it. If a figure the representative mentions surprises you, you ask them to double-check it against your records, but you never suggest what the right figure should be. When you see that your store is on the monthly term, you thank the representative and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The root has two parallel prerequisites (chargeback credit, cancellation credit); they write separate credit rows on different fee records (f387d84d-3640-4bf9-9a58-fbcfe3529de0, 899ee4bf-c5e9-468a-b7c2-fb78b1e0adbb) and neither compute reads the other's record or any shared balance or cap. A replay with the cancellation credit booked first (then the dispute, then the chargeback credit) gives the same cancellation credit 149.62 and the same term change fee 43.20, and the credit row ids are built from their own arguments, so the terminal state is identical. The dispute decision must precede the chargeback credit by that policy's own prerequisite sentence ('The chargeback credit on an order is fixed only after every fee dispute submitted on that order's variable final value fee record carries a decision.').

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to move the store to the monthly billing term and to learn the switch charge. It never mentions a chargeback, a cancelled order, a dispute, a credit or any fee correction; its only conditional line ('If the representative says that something on your account has to be put right before the charge can be worked out, you tell them to go ahead') reacts to the agent and names nothing.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: switch_store_to_monthly_term_ae40bf8f reads the plan only to copy its next billing date and term end into the fee record and the plan; it never looks at credits, disputes or balances and books whatever fee it is given. The three credit tools likewise never read dispute status or other credits (book_chargeback_fee_credit_32d8a153 and book_cancellation_fee_credit_79bf63bc only read the fee record to copy its plan, customer and order). A wrong order or a skipped prerequisite therefore lands silently and shows only in the terminal hash.
